title: 第7章  你自己说受不了的哦！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
风吹过空旷的宫廷走廊，卷起几片落叶，也卷走了他脸上最后的一丝血色。
赵辰宇伸出的手，就那么僵在了半空中。
他整个人都傻了。
李擎苍……就这么走了？
那个脾气火爆，敢在朝堂上跟御史对喷的莽夫，就这么无视了自己？
为什么？
父皇的圣旨，不是也损害了他李家的颜面吗？
他不是应该跟自己一样，愤怒、不甘，想尽办法阻止这一切吗？
一股前所未有的恐慌，攥住了赵辰宇的心脏。
他最后的希望，破灭了。
还有父皇！
只要自己能见到父皇，晓之以情，动之以理，或许还有转机！
赵辰宇猛地转身，发疯似的冲向御书房。
“父皇！儿臣求见父皇！”
他冲到殿门前，不顾一切地嘶吼着，甚至想用手去推那扇沉重的殿门。
“三皇子殿下，请留步。”
一个尖细的嗓音响起，御书房的总管太监带着两个小太监，幽灵般地出现在他面前，拦住了他的去路。
“让开！本皇子要见父皇！”
赵辰宇双目赤红，状若疯魔。
总管太监躬着身子，脸上却没什么恭敬，只是平铺直叙地传达着旨意。

“陛下口谕。”
赵辰宇的动作一滞。
“滚回去，禁足思过七日，无诏不得出府。”
滚……回去？
禁足……七日？
这几个字，每一个都化作一柄重锤，狠狠地砸在赵辰宇的天灵盖上。
他整个人都懵了，身体晃了晃，险些栽倒在地。
七日后，就是李青鸾和那个废物成婚的日子。
父皇这是……在用最直接，最不留情面的方式，断绝他所有的念想！
“不……为什么……”
赵辰宇失魂落魄地后退两步，嘴里喃喃自语。
他想不通。
自己究竟哪里比不上那个废物十六弟？
论修为，自己早已开辟苦海，命泉汩汩，神桥在望！
而赵辰安，连苦海都开辟不了！
论才学，自己熟读经史，策论文章屡获太傅称赞！
而赵辰安，斗鸡走狗，不学无术！
为什么父皇要如此偏袒他！
甚至不惜折辱李大将军，也要把一位道宫境的天之骄女，塞给他当侧妃！
总管太监看着他这副模样，只是微微垂下头，不再多言。

赵辰宇踉跄地转过身，行尸走肉般地朝着宫外走去。
彻彻底底的绝望。
然而，就在他即将走出宫门的那一刻，一个念头划过他混乱的脑海。
对，还有母妃！
淑贵妃，他唯一的依靠！
父皇可以不顾念父子之情，但母妃总会帮自己的！
一道新的光芒在他死寂的瞳孔中亮起，他加快了脚步，朝着后宫的方向狂奔而去。
御书房内。
赵道霆负手而立。
他那张威严的脸上，没有半点动容。
他缓缓闭上双目，整个人的气息沉静下来。
下一刻，一幕奇异的景象在他体内发生。
原本在他苦海之上，按照皇室功法修炼出的四极秘境，那连接天地四方的四根光柱，此刻竟在微微颤动。
一缕缕玄奥莫测的金色符文，凭空出现在他的神识之海中，化作一篇浩瀚无边的经文。
《大道天衍经》！
这正是赵辰安刚刚献上的天品功法！
仅仅是入门，赵道霆便感觉到，自己卡了十年之久的瓶颈，竟然有了松动的迹象。
那原本坚不可摧的化龙境壁垒，在这篇经文的运转之下，似乎也并非遥不可及。
“天品功法……果然神妙无穷。”
赵道霆缓缓吐出一口浊气，那股气息在空中凝而不散，竟隐隐有龙形盘绕。

他能感觉到，自己体内的每一滴血液，每一寸骨骼，都在发生着奇妙的蜕变。
突破化龙境，指日可待！
届时，他将成为大周王朝数百年来，第一位化龙境的君主！
而这一切的源头……
赵道霆的思绪，回到了自己那个不成器的十六子身上。
他至今也想不明白，为何自己儿子成个亲，会引来如此惊天的机缘。
那背后，必然站着一位无法想象的神秘大能。
而这位大能，似乎对自己儿子的婚事，很感兴趣。
“青鸾那丫头，道宫境的天资，可比乌家的女娃高出不少。”
赵道霆的嘴角，勾起一抹深沉的弧度。
“七日后，朕倒要看看，你又能给朕，给大周，带来什么样的惊喜。”
十六皇子府。
婚房之内，春意盎然。
锦被之下，一具玲珑有致的娇躯微微起伏，雪白的肌肤上透着一层醉人的粉红。
乌兰雪发丝凌乱，沾着细密的汗珠，贴在光洁的额角与脸颊。
她侧躺在赵辰安怀里，连抬起一根手指的力气都快没了。
“夫君……我……我真的不行了……”
她的嗓音带着一丝哭腔，软糯而沙哑，听得人心头发颤。
她本就是轮海境的修士，体力远超常人。
可她怎么也想不明白，自己这个连苦海都未能开辟的夫君，体力怎会恐怖到如此地步。

他就像一头不知疲倦的蛮龙，每一次的冲击，都让她神魂颠倒，溃不成军。
赵辰安低头，看着怀中娇喘吁吁的美人。
少女原本清冷的容颜，此刻被情潮染得艳若桃李。
那双秋水般的眸子，也蒙上了一层迷离的水雾，分外勾人。
他坏笑一声，手指轻轻刮过她小巧挺翘的鼻尖。
“这就扛不住了？”
“嗯……”
乌兰雪把脸埋进他坚实的胸膛，闷闷地应了一声，带着浓浓的委屈。
赵辰安凑到她耳边，温热的气息吹拂着她敏感的耳廓。
“那可就不能怪我了哦。”
乌兰雪一愣，没明白他的意思。
只听他继续用那带着笑意的声音说道。
“既然你一个人扛不住，那为夫再给你找个姐妹分担一下，也是合情合理的吧？”
“毕竟，是你自己说扛不住的。”
乌兰雪闻言，顿时脸红。
随后赶忙小鸡啄米一般点头。
赵辰安火力旺盛，尚未发泄完毕，目光正好瞟到她的樱桃小嘴。

content_en:
The wind blew through the empty palace corridor, picking up a few fallen leaves and taking away the last trace of blood from his face.
Zhao Chenyu's outstretched hand just froze in mid-air.
He was completely stunned.
Li Qingcang...just left like this?
That reckless man with a hot temper who dared to confront the censor in the court just ignored him?
Why?
Didn't his father's imperial edict also damage the face of his Li family?
Shouldn't he be as angry and unwilling as himself, and try his best to stop this?
An unprecedented panic gripped Zhao Chenyu's heart.
His last hope was shattered.
And my father!
As long as he can see his father, show affection to him, and act rationally, there may be a chance for a better future!
Zhao Chenyu turned around suddenly and rushed towards the imperial study room like crazy.
"Father! I want to see my father!"
He rushed to the palace door, roaring desperately, and even wanted to push the heavy palace door with his hand.
"Your Highness, Third Prince, please stay."
A high-pitched voice sounded, and the eunuch in charge of the royal study and two young eunuchs appeared in front of him like ghosts, blocking his way.
"Get out of the way! This prince wants to see his father!"
Zhao Chenyu's eyes were red and he looked like a madman.
The eunuch in charge bowed his body, but there was no respect on his face. He just conveyed his orders in a straightforward manner.
"Your Majesty orally."
Zhao Chenyu's movements stagnated.
"Go back, stay here and think about it for seven days, and you won't be able to leave the house without an edict."
Go... back?
Grounded...seven days?
Each of these words turned into a heavy hammer, hitting Zhao Chenyu's Tianling Cap hard.
He was completely stunned, his body swayed, and he almost fell to the ground.
Seven days later, it will be the day when Li Qingluan and that loser get married.
Father is... using the most direct and most ruthless way to cut off all his thoughts!
"No...why..."
Zhao Chenyu took two steps back in despair, muttering to himself.
He couldn't figure it out.
How can I be inferior to that good-for-nothing sixteenth brother?
In terms of cultivation, I have already opened up the sea of ​​suffering, the spring of life is gurgling, and the divine bridge is in sight!
And Zhao Chenan can't even open up the sea of ​​suffering!
When it comes to talent and learning, he is familiar with classics and history, and his policy articles have been praised by his masters many times!
And Zhao Chenan, the fighting cock lackey, is ignorant and incompetent!
Why does his father favor him so much!
Even at the expense of humiliating General Li, he wanted to give him a proud daughter of the Taoist palace as his concubine!
The chief eunuch looked at his appearance and just lowered his head slightly and said no more.
Zhao Chenyu turned around staggeringly and walked towards the outside of the palace like a zombie.
Complete despair.
However, just as he was about to walk out of the palace, an idea flashed through his chaotic mind.
Yes, there is also a mother-in-law!
Concubine Shu, his only support!
The father may not care about the relationship between father and son, but the mother and concubine will always help him!
A new light lit up in his dead pupils, he quickened his pace and ran towards the harem.
In the imperial study room.
Zhao Daoting stood with his hands behind his back.
There was no trace of emotion on his majestic face.
He slowly closed his eyes and his whole body became calm.
The next moment, a strange scene happened inside his body.
The four-pole secret realm that was originally above his sea of ​​suffering and cultivated according to the royal family's techniques, the four light pillars connecting the four directions of heaven and earth, were actually trembling slightly at this moment.
Wisps of mysterious golden runes appeared out of thin air in his sea of ​​consciousness, turning into a vast scripture.
"Dao Tian Yan Jing"!
This is exactly the heavenly skill that Zhao Chenan just presented!
Just after getting started, Zhao Daoting felt that the bottleneck he had been stuck in for ten years was showing signs of loosening.
The originally indestructible Dragon Transformation Realm barrier seems to be not out of reach under the operation of this scripture.
"Tianpin Kung Fu...is really wonderful."
Zhao Daoting slowly spit out a mouthfulThe turbid air condensed in the air without dissipating, and there was a faint dragon shape coiling around it.
He could feel that every drop of blood and every inch of bone in his body was undergoing a wonderful transformation.
Breaking through the dragon realm is just around the corner!
By then, he will become the first monarch in the Dragon Transformation Realm in the Zhou Dynasty for hundreds of years!
And the source of all this...
Zhao Daoting's thoughts returned to his incompetent Sixteenth Son.
He still can't figure out why his son's marriage would lead to such a shocking opportunity.
Behind that, there must be an unimaginable mysterious power standing.
And this powerful man seemed to be very interested in his son's marriage.
"That girl Qingluan's talent at the Taoist palace level is much higher than that of the girls from the Wu family."
The corners of Zhao Daoting's mouth curved into a deep arc.
"In seven days, I want to see what kind of surprise you can bring to me and to Dazhou."
The Sixteenth Prince's Mansion.
In the wedding room, spring is everywhere.
Under the brocade quilt, an exquisite and delicate body undulated slightly, with a layer of intoxicating pink on the snow-white skin.
Wu Lanxue's hair was messy, stained with fine beads of sweat, and stuck to her smooth forehead and cheeks.
She was lying on her side in Zhao Chenan's arms, almost losing the strength to even lift a finger.
"Husband...I...I really can't do it anymore..."
There was a hint of crying in her voice, soft and hoarse, which made people's hearts tremble.
She is a monk in the Wheel and Sea Realm, and her physical strength is far beyond that of ordinary people.
But she couldn't figure out how her husband, who couldn't even open up the sea of ​​suffering, could have such terrible physical strength.
He was like a tireless wild dragon. Every impact made her fascinated and defeated.
Zhao Chenan lowered his head and looked at the panting beauty in his arms.
The girl's originally cold face was now dyed as bright as a peach and plum by the tide of love.
Those autumn-like eyes were also covered with a layer of blurred mist, making them particularly attractive.
He smiled evilly and gently scraped the tip of her small and straight nose with his fingers.
"Can't you bear it anymore?"
"Well..."
Wu Lanxue buried her face into his solid chest and responded in a muffled voice, with deep grievance.
Zhao Chenan leaned close to her ear, and his warm breath blew against her sensitive ear.
"Then you can't blame me."
Wu Lanxue was stunned and didn't understand what he meant.
Just listen to him continue to speak in that smiling voice.
"Since you can't bear it alone, it's reasonable for my husband to find a sister for you to share the burden, right?"
"After all, it was you who said you couldn't bear it."
When Wu Lanxue heard this, she immediately blushed.
Then he hurriedly nodded like a chicken pecking at rice.
Zhao Chenan was full of fire and had not yet finished venting his anger. His eyes happened to catch a glimpse of her small cherry mouth.
